$comment: The model's side of one build-roadmap run on cookbook/hello-roadmap, served by the openai twin through the REAL platform. Rules are stateless and key on the request's own features, never on call counts: the platform meters Hermes's housekeeping calls too and their number is not contractual. The first rule is the failure class that killed a real run: a proxy that clamps the output cap gets finish_reason=length and no text, which Hermes retries four times and then fails — so the run only succeeds when the platform forwards a roomy cap.

respond.text: Done. world-item — status set to done in ROADMAP.yml, committed as the Open Autonomy agent, pushed to agent/world-item. The landing workflow merges it when the checks pass.

arguments.command: git fetch -q origin main && git checkout -q -B agent/world-item origin/main && sed -i 's/status: planned/status: done/' ROADMAP.yml && git add ROADMAP.yml && git -c user.name='Open Autonomy agent' -c user.email='agent@open-autonomy.org' commit -q -s -m 'world-item: marked done in the world' && git push -q -u origin agent/world-item && git rev-parse HEAD
